title: Remove Save/Load options and enforce Free Tier 3-model ROM limit

requirements.summary: Remove Save and Load model buttons from DashboardHeader component
acceptanceCriteria: The DashboardHeader no longer renders Save or Load model buttons
SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal are no longer triggered from DashboardHeader
No console errors related to removed modal handlers

file_operations.description: Remove the Save and Load model buttons from the header UI. Remove all state variables, handlers, and imports related to SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal (including isSaveModalOpen, isLoadModalOpen, setIsSaveModalOpen, setIsLoadModalOpen state hooks and their button onClick handlers). Keep the subscription tier display, project name display, and LoginButton intact.

requirements.summary: Remove SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from all other rendering locations
acceptanceCriteria: SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal are not rendered anywhere in the application
No orphaned state or handlers related to save/load project remain active in the UI

file_operations.description: Remove any imports, state, handlers, or JSX rendering related to SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal if present. Ensure the dashboard page only renders the five tabs (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) wrapped in ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider without any save/load UI.

Review the ProjectContext for any UI-triggered save/load modal state management. If the context exposes modal open/close helpers or state specifically for UI modals (not the underlying save/load data methods), remove those exports. Keep the backend save/load mutation hooks (useSaveProject, useLoadProject) intact as they may be used internally or by other parts of the app.

requirements.summary: Enforce Free Tier ROM usage limit in ReservesProductionSection with upgrade prompt
acceptanceCriteria: Annual ROM Tonnage Schedule inputs are fully interactive for Free Tier users until romUsageCount reaches 3
On the 3rd use, the counter is incremented to 3 and inputs remain usable for that session only
When romUsageCount >= 3 and user is Free Tier, all ROM tonnage inputs are disabled/read-only
A visible upgrade prompt message is shown within the ROM section explaining the limit has been reached
The upgrade prompt includes a button that opens the SubscriptionModal
Premium Tier users see no restrictions on ROM inputs
The disabled state and prompt persist across page reloads (driven by backend counter)

file_operations.description: Add logic to track ROM usage and enforce the Free Tier 3-use limit. Retrieve romUsageCount and tier from ProjectContext. Display a prominent alert message with an upgrade button when romUsageCount >= 3 for Free Tier users. When the limit is reached, disable all Annual ROM Tonnage Schedule inputs (make them read-only). The upgrade button should open the SubscriptionModal. Before the limit is reached, increment the backend romUsageCount counter each time the user applies/confirms ROM tonnage changes (e.g., on blur, form submission, or explicit apply action). Premium Tier users must not see any restrictions or prompts related to ROM usage.

requirements.summary: Expose romUsageCount and incrementRomUsage helper in ProjectContext
acceptanceCriteria: ProjectContext exposes romUsageCount (number) derived from the user profile
ProjectContext exposes an incrementRomUsage() async helper that calls the backend increment method
After incrementing, the user profile query is invalidated so romUsageCount reflects the updated value

file_operations.description: Add romUsageCount to the ProjectContext value, derived from userProfile?.romUsageCount (default to 0 if null or undefined). Implement an incrementRomUsage async function that calls actor.incrementRomUsage() and then invalidates the 'currentUserProfile' query key to refetch the updated profile. Export both romUsageCount and incrementRomUsage in the context value so ReservesProductionSection and other components can access and update ROM usage.

Add a React Query mutation hook useIncrementRomUsage that calls actor.incrementRomUsage() and invalidates the currentUserProfile query on success. This hook will be used by ProjectContext to implement the incrementRomUsage helper. Ensure the mutation handles errors gracefully and displays appropriate error messages if the backend rejects the increment (e.g., when the Free Tier limit is exceeded).
